title: Mission 11: The Reading Room
story: The merger dumped a 3,000-line policy manual on the department, and the director wants answers from inside it by end of day. Nobody scrolls a wall of cat output - the reading room runs on pagers. less lets you move, search, jump to the end and back, and leave without a trace. Your answers prove you can drive it.

badge.name: The Reading Room: Well Read
badge.desc: Mastered less and more by pulling precise answers out of a 3,000-line manual.

tasks.brief: Read BRIEFING11.txt in your department directory. Open readingroom/manual.txt in a pager (less manual.txt - space pages down, q quits). The FIRST line of the manual is its title. Write that exact line to readingroom/title.txt.

checks.fail: title.txt must contain exactly the manual's first line (open the pager; the title is right there on screen one).

tasks.brief: In the pager, jump straight to the END of the manual (capital G in less) - the final line is the revision stamp. Write that exact line to readingroom/revision.txt.

checks.fail: revision.txt must contain exactly the manual's final line (G jumps to the end in less).

tasks.brief: Somewhere in the manual one line names the emergency code word '$MISSION_CODE'. In less, / searches forward. Find that line and write it - the whole line, exactly - to readingroom/codeline.txt.

checks.fail: codeline.txt must contain the exact manual line naming the emergency code (search with / in less).

tasks.brief: The auditors flagged line 1500 exactly. In less, typing a number then g jumps to that line (1500g). What does line 1500 say? The whole line, exactly, to readingroom/line1500.txt.

checks.fail: line1500.txt must contain exactly what the manual says on line 1500 (number + g jumps there in less).

tasks.brief: Every section heading in the manual starts with 'SECTION '. How many sections are there? Hunt them in the pager (n repeats a search) or count them any way you trust - the number goes in readingroom/sectioncount.txt.

checks.fail: sectioncount.txt must contain the number of SECTION headings in the manual.

tasks.brief: The lobby kiosk only has more (the older pager: space pages, q quits, no going back). Use more on readingroom/notice.txt and copy its ONLY line mentioning visitors - exactly - to readingroom/visitors.txt.

checks.fail: visitors.txt must contain the notice's exact visitor line (more pages forward only - read carefully the first time).
The manual was modified. A pager READS - that is its entire virtue; the library noticed.

tasks.brief: BONUS: less shows your position as a percentage (the ruler at the bottom, or -N shows line numbers). The code-word line you found in t03: is it in the FIRST or SECOND half of the manual? Write exactly 'first' or 'second' to readingroom/half.txt.

checks.fail: half.txt must say which half of the manual holds the code line: first or second (watch less's position indicator).
